column1: - Produced by `scripts/import_taxon_list.py` when the source list carries a download URL
or a `wget ... -O <name>` command (for example the GMPS per-species manifest).
- `url` must be the bare URL; the `wget` prefix and `-O` flag are parsed out, so this
column can be fed to a downloader without shell rewriting.
- `archive` is the suggested local filename taken from the source command. It may be
empty when the source gives only a URL.
- A manifest is an alternative to genome accessions: GMPS packages per species and ships
no GCF/GCA, so download-by-URL is the only route for that source. Record the source
repository and checksum in the accompanying provenance file.
